title: Excellent private tour!
text: We enjoyed the private tour. Nicely paced and our guide shared a lot of  excellent information about the basilica. Excellent tour.
author: Sharon_B

title: Guide Emilio 5⭐️
text: Emilio, our guide, was really good! Unfortunately we booked at 5:00 PM and at 6:00 PM they were already making us leave ☹️ but in a short time he managed to explain so many things to us in a simple and fun way! You can see that he has passion for what he does and for what he says! We would have listened to him for another hour! If I were to return I would choose him again! Top! Thanks❤️
author: Lorenzo_V
